propositions: gerrit_client.clone_change_ref contains five unbounded subprocess.run calls, two network-capable (fetch operations), risking indefinite hangs and credential disclosure via TimeoutExpired.cmd
workspace._git helper passes no timeout to subprocess.run, leaving all git calls in the module unbounded including two network-capable fetch operations
_ref_lock.py is already fully bounded with timeout as a required keyword parameter; the sweep note is stale and the module requires no edits

Cold-fetch operations (git init + deep fetch into fresh directories) require _GIT_TIMEOUT=300s matching the 747f precedent, not the 30s incremental-push profile of _store modules
